messages.content: After Andrea saved some money, she then spent the rest of her money on an $11 sweater and gave her brother $4. If she had $36 in the beginning, how much did Andrea save?

content.text:
Let me work through this problem.

Andrea started with $36. She saved some amount, then spent the rest on an $11 sweater and gave her brother $4.

So: Savings + $11 (sweater) + $4 (brother) = $36

Savings = $36 - $11 - $4 = **$21**

Andrea saved **$21**.
